DOPPLER_TOKEN.description: A service token, shown once. It carries its own scope, so it names the project and config rather than needing them beside it. An ephemeral token can be given a maximum age and then deletes itself.

DOPPLER_PROJECT.description: Which project, for commands not using a scoped token. An identifier that authenticates nothing.

DOPPLER_CONFIG.description: Which config within it. Same kind of value as above.
